dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: OK, class. You don't have to do homework this week.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ, ˈklæs. juː ˈdoʊnt ˈhæf tə ˈduː ˈhoʊmwɜːrk ðɪs ˈwiːk.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: But you have to study. The exam is next Monday.
dialogue.reading: bʌt juː ˈhæf tə ˈstʌdi. ði ɪɡˈzæm ɪz ˈnɛkst ˈmʌndeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh no! I don't want to fail.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ! aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈwɑːnt tə ˈfeɪl.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Don't worry. You can pass. You don't have to get an A.
dialogue.reading: ˈdoʊnt ˈwɜːri. juː kən ˈpæs. juː ˈdoʊnt ˈhæf tə ˈɡɛt ən ˈeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: But I want a good grade!
dialogue.reading: bʌt aɪ ˈwɑːnt ə ˈɡʊd ˈɡreɪd!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Good. But a student doesn't have to be perfect, Nam.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd. bʌt ə ˈstuːdənt ˈdʌzənt ˈhæf tə bi ˈpɜːrfɪkt, ˈnɑːm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I know. I can study every evening this week.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈnoʊ. aɪ kən ˈstʌdi ˈɛvri ˈiːvnɪŋ ðɪs ˈwiːk.
